Zizou Bergs is buzzing due to his surprising wins and rising profile in professional tennis.
Peter Skoronski is buzzing as a top offensive line prospect for the upcoming NFL draft.
John Goodman is buzzing for his recent acclaimed roles and career resurgence.

en.joke: My coffee machine notified me it's 'sensing low productivity.' Pretty sure it just watched me scroll for 20 minutes.
en.explanation: Funny because a machine, designed for utility, is now anthropomorphized to observe and judge human idleness.

zh.joke: 我司的KPI，已经脱离了实际业务，上升到了形而上学的层面，主要考核员工的精神内耗强度。

people.name: Eamonn Darcy
people.extract: Eamonn Christopher Darcy is an Irish professional golfer. He won four times on the European Tour and played in the Ryder Cup four times.
highlights: Won four times on the European Tour.
Played in the Ryder Cup four times.

people.name: Lana Cantrell
people.extract: Lana Eleanor Cantrell AM is an Australian-American singer and entertainment lawyer. She was nominated for the Grammy Award for Best New Artist in the Grammy Awards of 1968.
highlights: Nominated for Grammy Award for Best New Artist (1968).

people.name: Karol Zalewski
people.extract: Karol Zalewski is a Polish athlete who specialises in the sprinting events. He reached the semifinals of the 2013 World Championships in the 200 metres. He is also the 2013 European U23 champion over that distance.
highlights: Polish athlete specializing in sprinting events.
